dar.help.clinical-time: Describes the absence of the clinical time, not whether the event occurred.
dar.help.coding: Describes missing structured coding; retain the coding system and profile slice.
dar.help.document-content: Describes missing document bytes. URL, size and hash must be handled consistently.
dar.help.dose: Describes the absence of a structured dose, not a laboratory measurement.
dar.help.measurement: Describes the missing nonnumeric measurement; the reason replaces the entire measurement value.
dar.help.numeric-measurement: Describes the missing numeric measurement; the reason replaces the entire measurement value.
dar.help.status: Describes a missing status. Related clinical/profile constraints still apply.
dar.help.text: Describes missing descriptive information; do not use numeric error codes.
dar.help.version: Describes the missing coding-system version, not the clinical event.
